description: Requires signing in to GearHost. Let one of the user's CloudSites take payments (GearHost Store): returns a link where the user connects their OWN Stripe account (or creates one) on Stripe's website; buyers then pay on Stripe-hosted pages and the money goes straight to the user. Nothing is charged by this tool. Give the user the link to open themselves. If payments are already on, says so. Then use save_products and add the returned Buy buttons to the site. Returns structuredContent { status, site, payments_ready, connect_url }.

site.description: The CloudSite address (list_my_sites shows them), e.g. "glowing-raven.gearhost.io" or its custom domain.

name: set_up_store

connect_url.description: Stripe page for the user to open (expires after a few minutes; call again for a new one).

title: Set up online payments
